issues.description: Return type of Lecture.getTotalNumberOfStudents() is inconsistent: the UML in problem_statement.md declares +getTotalNumberOfStudents(): String, but the reference solution implements getTotalNumberOfStudents() returning int (and other tasks imply a numeric total). Students following the UML literally would implement a String return type, conflicting with the intended API and breaking dependent methods/tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make all artifacts consistent by updating the UML in problem_statement.md to "+getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int" (and ensure tests expect int). If a String return type is truly intended instead, change the solution (and any dependent methods/tests such as getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents and getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor) to use String consistently.
